verdict.rationale: Ollama documents using its own Ollama Cloud models alongside local models through the same CLI and API: `ollama launch` works "with local or cloud models," and the docs give both local and cloud base URLs. However, the only cloud provider evidenced is Ollama's own cloud, not third-party providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic. The Claude, ChatGPT and Codex integrations point those tools at Ollama, not the reverse. Missing for 10: connecting third-party cloud AI providers (e.g., OpenAI or Anthropic API keys) inside Ollama, evidence of a unified model picker mixing local and cloud models in the desktop app, and hands-on corroboration of mixed local/cloud use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface

citations.quote: ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models.
Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
Ollama is the easiest way to run open AI models locally or in the cloud
